title: If We Voted Tonight
text: "If the colony voted tonight, the Devoted would carry it. They'd do whatever you told them. Anything."

lines.text: "That should feel safe. It doesn't. If something else ever does the telling, they won't know the difference. I'm not sure I would."

notes: Says the colony's lean before Trust decides (v0.91.0): the bloc that would carry a vote, read at home after the Foundry; one of the three, once (lean-told). The Clause wakes a little later (clause-6 +3 lead, clause-patience).
